metadata.title: Envoke Email Campaign Platform - Entra ID SSO Integration SSPP
metadata.remarks: Slim SSPP instance documenting Envoke integration with institutional Entra ID SSO. Authentication and coarse-grained access control are enforced by Entra ID; fine-grained authorization is enforced within the Envoke service.

import-profile.remarks: Inherits all normative identity, authentication, MFA, conditional access, logging, and governance requirements from the Entra ID SSO SSPP template.

system-characteristics.system-description: Email campaign platform using institutional Entra ID Single Sign-On for authentication and coarse-grained access control, with service-internal role-based authorization.

props.name: authentication-protocol
props.remarks: Envoke authenticates users via OpenID Connect federation with Entra ID.

props.name: local-credentials
props.remarks: Local Envoke user passwords are disabled; all interactive access requires Entra ID authentication.

props.name: multi-factor-authentication
props.remarks: MFA enforcement is inherited from Entra ID conditional access policies.

props.name: coarse-grained-authorization
props.remarks: Access to the Envoke service is restricted to authorized Entra ID groups.

props.name: fine-grained-authorization
props.remarks: Authorization within Envoke is enforced using service-defined roles, independent of Entra ID groups.

props.name: identity-lifecycle
props.remarks: User provisioning and deprovisioning are governed by authoritative HR and identity systems via Entra ID access control.

components.title: Envoke SSO Integration
components.description: Federated authentication with Entra ID providing identity assurance and access gating for the Envoke service.

links.text: Inherits institutional SSO and identity security controls.

components.remarks: Entra ID determines who may access Envoke. Envoke enforces all application-specific role permissions internally.

control-implementation.remarks: Authentication, MFA, conditional access, and access eligibility are inherited from Entra ID. Application role enforcement is handled within the Envoke service.
